autyism-le.bedrock.creative_mode: Bedrock mode cannot be used in creative mode!
autyism-le.bedrock.mod_missing: No supported bedrock breaking mod installed (bedrockminer / bedrock-miner / blockminer)!
autyism-le.block.mismatch: Block %s has mismatched block below, skipping placement
autyism-le.block.no_support: Block %s has no support below, skipping placement
autyism-le.config.bedrock.desc: Invoke BedrockMiner mod to achieve bedrock mining. This feature is unavailable if the mod is not installed.
autyism-le.config.bedrockEnabled.desc: Toggle for the bedrock breaking module.
autyism-le.config.breakBlacklist.desc:
Prohibit mining blocks in this list.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
autyism-le.config.breakBlocksPerTick.des:
Number of blocks that can be broken per game tick. Higher values mean more blocks broken each time (provided the blocks can be broken within one game tick).
Set to §b0§r for no limit, you can try enabling §6§lUse Packet Placement§r to optimize efficiency.
autyism-le.config.breakCheckHardness.des: Whether to skip unbreakable blocks (blocks with hardness of -1). If only the hardness of certain blocks has been modified on the server side, you can disable this option.
autyism-le.config.breakCooldown.desc: Cooldown time after breaking blocks at the same location (in game ticks). Retry breaking operation only after cooldown ends.
autyism-le.config.breakInstantOnSameTick:
When enabled, instantly breaks blocks when mining progress exceeds 70% within the same game tick. Improves mining efficiency on compatible servers.
§l§cNOTE:§r This feature is only available in certain cases.
autyism-le.config.breakInterval.desc:
Interval time for breaking blocks (in game ticks).
Set to 0 for no interval (may cause server lag), recommended to set to 1-5 to balance speed and performance.
autyism-le.config.breakLimit.desc:
Block filtering rules for mining mode.
§dNo Limit§r: No restriction on any block mining
§dWhitelist§r: Only allow mining blocks in whitelist
§dBlacklist§r: Prohibit mining blocks in blacklist
§lNote:§r When using Tweakeroo mining limit presets, this setting will not take effect.§r
autyism-le.config.breakLimiter.desc:
Source of mining limit rules:
§dTweakeroo Preset§r: Use Tweakeroo mod's mining limit rules
§dCustom§r: Use printer's custom mining limit rules.
autyism-le.config.breakProgressThreshold:
Progress threshold when mining blocks. Mining is considered complete when this percentage is reached.
Higher values mean lower mining efficiency; lower values mean faster mining efficiency.
Since the break progress reaches 70% after the first game tick, then wait for end mining packet reception,
you can lower it on servers without additional mining detection. :)
autyism-le.config.breakUsePacket.desc: Use sending mining packets instead of conventional mining logic, which can theoretically speed up mining efficiency.
autyism-le.config.breakWhitelist.desc:
Only allow mining blocks in this list.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
autyism-le.config.cycleMode.desc: Cycle through working modes in order: Print → Mine → Fill → Fluid → Bedrock. Also enables the work switch.
autyism-le.config.containerReturnInterva: Cooldown between container return attempts (in game ticks). Higher values reduce network overhead but increase delay before items are returned.
autyism-le.config.debugOutput.desc:
When enabled, console will output printer debug information.
If §6§lShow Work Status§r is also enabled, some information will also be displayed in the operation interface.
autyism-le.config.easyPlaceProtocol.desc:
Use Servex's easy place protocol to handle block placement correction during printing.
§lNote:§r This feature only works in single-player or on servers with Servux installed.
autyism-le.config.excavateBlacklist.desc:
Prohibit mining blocks in this list.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
autyism-le.config.excavateLimit.desc:
Block filtering rules for mining mode.
§dNo Limit§r: No restriction on any block mining
§dWhitelist§r: Only allow mining blocks in whitelist
§dBlacklist§r: Prohibit mining blocks in blacklist
§lNote:§r When using Tweakeroo mining limit presets, this setting will not take effect.§r
autyism-le.config.mineInstantOnly.desc:
When enabled, mining only breaks blocks the current tool (including Tweakeroo tool switch) can break instantly; blocks that need continuous mining are skipped.
With max Efficiency and Haste this clears sand, dirt, stone, etc. in the whole work range at once.
autyism-le.config.excavateLimiter.desc:
Source of mining limit rules:
§dTweakeroo Preset§r: Use Tweakeroo mod's mining limit rules
§dCustom§r: Use printer's custom mining limit rules.
autyism-le.config.excavateWhitelist.desc:
Only allow mining blocks in this list.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
autyism-le.config.fill.desc: Within the selection range, place blocks configured in §6Fill Block List§r.
autyism-le.config.fillBlockList.desc: Block list used by filling mode, configuration rules consistent with "Basic Block List".
In held item mode, items in this list are prohibited from being used for filling, preventing accidental use of fireworks etc.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:firework_rocket§r §bfirework§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:boats§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lfirework,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
autyism-le.config.fillBlockMode.desc:
Block selection mode for filling.
§dBlock List§r: Use blocks in configured list
§dHeld Item§r: Use currently held block in main hand
autyism-le.config.fillModeFacing.desc: Facing settings when filling blocks. For example, placing upper slabs or lower slabs.
autyism-le.config.fillSelectionType.desc:
Fill area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Fill across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only fill within Litematica's currently visible area
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height
autyism-le.config.fluid.desc: At lava sources and water sources positions, default place blocks configured in §6Fluid Replacement Block List§r.
autyism-le.config.fluidEnabled.desc: Toggle for the fluid removal module.
autyism-le.config.fluidList.desc: List of liquids that need to be replaced, can only input liquid IDs, example: §bminecraft:water§r.
autyism-le.config.fluidModeFillFlowing.d: When enabled, flowing liquids will also be treated as targets needing filling and replacement.
Block list for filling liquids. Can input item ID or displayed name, example: §bminecraft:sand§r §bsand§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:sand§r.
autyism-le.config.fluidSelectionType.des:
Fluid removal area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Remove fluid across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only remove fluid within Litematica's currently visible area
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height
autyism-le.config.highlightColor.desc: Color with alpha (hex AARRGGBB). Example: §b80FF0000§r for 50% red
autyism-le.config.highlightColorPlace.de: Color for successful block placement (hex AARRGGBB)
autyism-le.config.highlightEnabled.desc: Highlight blocks being processed during printing
Fade-out duration after placement (units of 0.1s. 10 = 1 second)
Allow highlights to be visible through blocks
autyism-le.config.iterationTimeLimit.des:
Maximum time for block iteration per game tick (milliseconds).
Set to 0 to disable.
Default 10 ms balances performance and speed, adjust as needed.
autyism-le.config.classifyByBlock.desc: When enabled, each full iteration sweep processes only one block type (the first required item found in the sweep); positions requiring other items are skipped until the sweep is exhausted, reducing item switching. Disabled by default for simple single-pass iteration.
autyism-le.config.mine.desc: Mine all non-liquid blocks within selection range.
autyism-le.config.mineSelectionType.desc:
Mining area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Mine across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only mine within Litematica's currently visible area
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height (default)
autyism-le.config.missingMaterialHud.des: Show missing materials HUD overlay in Litematica's material list area
autyism-le.config.openScreen.desc: Hotkey to open printer settings menu (the page you're currently viewing).
autyism-le.config.placeBlocksPerTick.des:
Number of blocks that can be placed per game tick. Higher values mean more blocks placed each time.
Set to §b0§r for no limit. On servers with packet restrictions, you can try enabling §6§lUse Packet Placement§r to optimize efficiency.
autyism-le.config.placeCooldown.desc:
Cooldown time after placing blocks at the same location (in game ticks). Retry placement operation only after cooldown ends.
§c§lDo not set to 0 unless necessary, otherwise it will cause placing extra blocks, inability to place correctly and other issues!§r
autyism-le.config.placeInAir.desc: Ignore block support requirements and place blocks directly in air positions (applicable to unsupported decorative blocks).
autyism-le.config.placeInterval.desc:
Interval time for placing blocks (in game ticks).
May automatically add delays to avoid placement errors for some special blocks.
Setting to 0 may cause poor performance on servers with packet restrictions.
Not recommended to set to 0 when printing redstone mechanisms.
autyism-le.config.placeUsePacket.desc:
Use sending placement packets instead of conventional placement logic to reduce "ghost block" phenomenon.
Can try enabling this in environments with packet restrictions.
autyism-le.config.printAutoFillComposter:
Automatically fill compostable items into composters to generate bone meal.
(§lWarning: This operation will consume compostable items in inventory!§r)

Compostable items used for automatic composter filling.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:wheat§r §bwheat§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#compostable§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching (prioritizing pinyin/direct matching), example: §lwheat,c§r.
autyism-le.config.printAutoStripLogs.des: When enabled, if stripped logs are not in inventory, will first place normal logs, then automatically strip them with axe to save manual operation time.
autyism-le.config.printAutoTuning.desc: When printing note blocks, automatically tune note blocks to the pitch specified in schematic.
autyism-le.config.printBonemealCrops.des: Use bone meal to grow crops.
autyism-le.config.printBreakExtraBlock.d: Automatically break extra blocks that don't exist in schematic during printing.
autyism-le.config.printBreakWrongBlock.d: Automatically break blocks that completely mismatch the schematic during printing.
autyism-le.config.printBreakWrongStateBl:
Automatically break blocks whose type matches schematic but state doesn't, and need to be broken for adjustment during printing.
Examples: stairs/slabs with wrong orientation, vines with extra faces, etc.; blocks that can be corrected by clicking (like trapdoors, campfires) won't be broken.
autyism-le.config.printFallingBlockCheck: When enabled, will check if blocks below falling blocks match schematic, and skip placement if incorrect.
autyism-le.config.printForcedSneak.desc: Automatically maintain sneaking state during printing process.
autyism-le.config.printIceForWater.desc: Generate water source blocks through "place ice → break ice" method to achieve water source printing.
autyism-le.config.printReplace.desc: Directly overwrite blocks in list without skipping processing or breaking.
autyism-le.config.printReplaceCoral.desc: When printing dead coral, if no dead coral in inventory, use live coral as substitute; if both exist, will prioritize using dead coral.
autyism-le.config.printReplaceableList.d:
Block list that can be directly overwritten during printing (without breaking original blocks).
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching, example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
autyism-le.config.printSafelyObserver.de: Check if suitable for placement before placing observers to avoid accidentally triggering your machines and causing disasters.
autyism-le.config.printSelectionType.des:
Print area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Print across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only print within Litematica's currently visible area (render layer + sub-region visibility)
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height (default)
autyism-le.config.printSkip.desc: When enabled, will skip blocks in the list during printing.
autyism-le.config.printSkipList.desc:
Block list skipped during printing. Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching, example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
autyism-le.config.printerAutoDisable.des: Automatically disable printer when player dies to avoid misoperations after respawning.
autyism-le.config.printerIteratorMode.de:
Block iteration order during printing:
§dXYZ§r: X axis first, then Y axis, finally Z axis
§dXZY§r: X axis first, then Z axis, finally Y axis
§dYXZ§r: Y axis first, then X axis, finally Z axis
§dYZX§r: Y axis first, then Z axis, finally X axis
§dZXY§r: Z axis first, then X axis, finally Y axis
§dZYX§r: Z axis first, then Y axis, finally X axis
autyism-le.config.printerIteratorShape.d:
Area shape for printer block iteration:
§dCube§r: Cube with §6§lWork Radius§r as edge length (recommended value: 3)
§dSphere§r: Sphere with §6§lWork Radius§r as radius (recommended value: 6)
§dOctahedron§r: Octahedron with §6§lWork Radius§r as edge length (recommended value: 6)
autyism-le.config.printerLagCheckMax.des: used as the upper limit for lag detection.
autyism-le.config.printerXAxisReverse.de: When enabled, X axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
autyism-le.config.printerYAxisReverse.de: When enabled, Y axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
autyism-le.config.printerZAxisReverse.de: When enabled, Z axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
Block IDs recognized as containers for remote item retrieval. Format: minecraft:chest, minecraft:trapped_chest, etc.
autyism-le.config.renderHud.desc:
Display current mode and work progress within range on operation page when printer is working;
If §6§lLag Detection§r is enabled, will show prompt when lag is excessive.
autyism-le.config.returnToContainerWhenF: When trying to take a new item and inventory is full, automatically return the earliest tracked item back to its source container to free space.
autyism-le.config.returnToShulkerWhenFul: When inventory is full, return the currently held item back to the shulker box slot before taking a new item from it.
autyism-le.config.shulkerCooldown.desc: Cooldown in ticks before another shulker box can be opened. Range: 0-20.
autyism-le.config.shulkerSource.desc: Choose shulker box support type: Mod (Quick Shulker client-side mod), Plugin (AxShulkers server-side plugin), or TakeItOut (server-side mod).
autyism-le.config.updateCheck.desc: Automatically check for mod updates when first entering world.
autyism-le.config.useQuickShulker.desc: When materials are missing from inventory but available inside open shulker boxes (via Quick Shulker mod), automatically take items from them.
autyism-le.config.useRemoteContainer.des: When materials are missing from inventory, attempt to retrieve them from containers within the schematic selection area via the Remote Inventory Server mod installed on the server.
autyism-le.config.workRange.desc:
Printer's maximum work radius centered on player (blocks).
§a0 (default)§r: Auto-uses player's reach (creative §b6§r, survival §b4.5§r, server-enforced).
§a> 0§r: Custom override (may exceed server limits).
This parameter is associated with §6§lIteration Area Shape§r.
autyism-le.free_notice: This mod requires further i18n and l10n. If you do, thank you!
autyism-le.hud.missing.title: §cMissing: §e%d §7types
autyism-le.ice.creative_mode: Breaking ice in creative mode will not produce water!
autyism-le.ice.water_timeout: Water generation timed out (no water within 60 ticks), printer disabled!
autyism-le.update.available: Litematica Printer detected new version! Current version: %s, latest version: %s
autyism-le.update.download: >> Click here to download latest version <<
autyism-le.update.failed: Update check failed, please try again later.
autyism-le.update.recommendation: Strongly recommend upgrading to latest version to fix potential serious issues.
autyism-le.bedrock.not_support: Not supported in original Bedrock Miner, please use bunnyi port version
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.autyism-l: Personal Litematica enhancement pack with a built-in printer.
autyism-le.config.breakAutoToolSwitch.de: Automatically switch to the most effective tool from the whole inventory before breaking (built-in, Tweakeroo not required).
autyism-le.config.breakToolDurabilityPro: If the tool that would be used has remaining durability at or below the threshold, the printer does NOT fall back to another tool: it stops all breaking, swaps your hand to an item that cannot break (prefers blocks) and shows a warning. Repair/replace the tool and toggle the printer off and on to continue.
autyism-le.config.breakToolDurabilityThr: Tools with remaining durability <= this value are protected.
autyism-le.message.tool_low_durability: §e%s has only %s durability left - breaking stopped to protect it. Repair/replace it, then toggle the printer off and on.
autyism-le.config.pauseOnContainer.desc: Pause the printer from the moment you right-click a chest/shulker/entity container until shortly after the container is closed. Prevents the client and server from disagreeing about your inventory (which made the printer place wrong blocks while you took materials).
autyism-le.config.bedrockBackend.desc: Which bedrock breaking mod the bedrock mode drives. Auto: bedrockminer (bunnyi116) > bedrock-miner (lxyan2333) > blockminer.
autyism-le.config.bedrockIgnoreRenderLay: Break all bedrock inside the Litematica area selection regardless of the current render layer range.
